title: AMOC-Kipppunkt — interactive UTAC-logistic sandbox for amoc-utac (P18)
description: Interactive physics sandbox for the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation, porting the calibrated UTAC-logistic ODE and CREP Gamma composition directly from GenesisAeon's amoc-utac (P18) constants and crep_amoc.py -- no invented numbers. Displays the corrected Ditlevsen et al. tipping-year estimate and the IPCC AR6 consensus position as explicit context, not as the sandbox's own prediction. Part of the GenesisAeon interactive-sandbox series.
